# env panels (6HP)

| Directory | Contents |
|---|---|
| `front-pcb/` | Native passive FR4 panel `env-panel.kicad_{pro,pcb}`: 30.0 x 128.5 x 1.6 mm, NPTH only, F.SilkS labels. Generated by `../tools/build_layout.py` from `../docs/geometry.json` |
| `front-cad/` | FreeCAD printable panel, 2.0 mm thick, plain (no labels): `build_front_panel.py`, `.FCStd`, `.step`, `.stl` |

Holes: jacks Ø6.2, pots Ø7.2, LEDs Ø3.2, MODE / REC buttons Ø4.2, rail holes Ø3.2 at X12.58.
The buttons need the modules/8bit printed cap through their hole. The printed panel has the same holes;
the caps stand 1.5 mm proud of it, as on modules/8bit.

Regenerate the printed panel headless from `modules/env`:

```sh
freecadcmd panels/front-cad/build_front_panel.py
```

The script reads the outline and holes from `front-pcb/env-panel.kicad_pcb` and asserts them
against `docs/geometry.json`; it checks a single valid solid, the drilled-blank volume and a
closed manifold STL. Print suggestion: PETG/ABS, front face down, 0.2 mm layers. Holes are
nominal: ream after printing. LED domes sit 0.4 mm behind the print front. Not test-printed; no physical-fit claim.
